concepts.description: A module is a component of the system architecture.
A robotic platform is a physical or logical entity that performs autonomous operations.
A controller is a component that manages or directs other parts of the system.
A primitive type is a basic data type provided by the system.
A composite type is a data type composed of multiple fields.
An interface defines a set of values or events that a component provides or requires.
A function is a named operation that performs a computation.
